title: fix(lint)!: ten publish-time checks for flows that save and do not run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ82m9WTJKrcL1TbDtF6CnzSt)_

Part of #35143 — this is the card's Flows family. The Data model, Views/dashboards/app shell, and Seeds/actions families stay open on the card for later PRs (premise table: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35143#issuecomment-7098105309).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-automation/references/examples-flows.md, skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md

## 维护者速读

- 搭建者发布流程时,以前能保存却永远不跑、跑错对象或每次写入都失败的七类流程,现在发布当场被拒并告诉怎么改;另有三类只提醒不拦。
- 属于「各种搭建方式共用的底座:发布前检查」专题的第二批,托管搭建删掉自家重复检查之前要等它。
- 已保存的流程不受影响,下次重新发布才会被拦;误拦时改回即可,本改动可整体撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

Seven errors, judged by the runtime publish gate and by `os validate` / `lint` / `compile` / `build`:

| Rule | What it catches | Why it fails at run time |
|---|---|---|
| `flow-trigger-object-missing` | a record-triggered start node with no or a blank `objectName` | absent: the hook registers with no object, so it fires on writes to every object; blank: the engine refuses the hook, so the flow never starts |
| `flow-condition-option-label` | a start condition comparing a select field with one of its option **labels** (`F == 'L'`, `'L' == F`, `!=`, `F in [...]`) | the row stores the option value, so it is never true |
| `flow-time-relative-shadowed` | `timeRelative` under a record `triggerType` | the record trigger wins; the sweep never runs |
| `flow-time-relative-key-misplaced` | `filter` / `maxRecords` beside `timeRelative` | the sweep reads them only inside the block |
| `flow-time-relative-date-field-invalid` | `dateField` missing or not `date` / `datetime` | the range query matches no record |
| `flow-node-write-unknown-option` | a create/update node writing a select literal no option carries | the record validator refuses `invalid_option` on every run |
| `flow-node-write-date-helper-text` | a create/update node writing `'today()'`-style text to a date field | the validator refuses `invalid_date`; the hint gives the CEL value envelope |

Three warnings: `flow-schedule-timezone-missing` (cron with no `timezone` runs in UTC), `flow-subflow-unknown` (new CLI-only rule `validateFlowSubflowTargets`: a `subflow`/`map` node naming a flow the stack and its packages do not carry), `flow-create-update-pair` (an after-create and an after-update flow on one object with the same nodes; fingerprinted on the whole node minus `id`/`label`/`description`/`position`).

- One reading of a select field's options, `packages/lint/src/flow-select-options.ts`, shared by the two option rules: a field is judged only when its options are inline (no shared `picklist`) and no two object extensions tie on it.
- Ten `os explain` entries in `rule-explanations.ts`.
- Upgrade-guide entry `publish-refuses-flows-that-save-and-do-not-run` (ADR-0087, notice only; no D2 conversion).
- Docs and spec docblocks: the cron examples in `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`, `time-relative-trigger.zod.ts` and `schedule-organization.zod.ts` state `timezone: 'UTC'`; the two reference pages are regenerated.
- Examples: four cron schedules in `app-todo` and `app-showcase` gain `timezone: 'UTC'`; four CLI transcripts in `content/docs/` print 77 author-time rules.

## Tests

- New `packages/lint/src/flow-publish-checks-second-batch.test.ts` (33 tests): a positive and a silent pin per rule, the runtime-gate refusal for each error, the subflow rule running on the CLI and not on the gate, a `connectorConfig` regression case for the pair rule, and `explainRule` for all ten ids.
- `validate-flow-trigger-readiness.test.ts`: four fixtures gained `timezone: 'UTC'` so the #5647 and #17396 tests keep judging only their own question (fixture triage; no assertion narrowed or removed).

## Acceptance notes

- **F6 (`flow-subflow-unknown`) is a CLI-only warning, not an error.** The publish gate judges a flow write over a snapshot that holds only that flow, and another package may ship the called flow, so a gate-side or error-tier check would refuse valid flows.
- **F3 (self-retriggering flow) is not built**: refuted on main (re-entry guard and driver-sql boolean read-back), evidence in the premise table.
- **F4c and F7b are already covered** (`flow-trigger-unknown-object`; `date-text-call` from #34451).
- The label check covers **start conditions** only; decision-node conditions are not judged here.
- The flow-CRUD unknown-object line (S2) goes with a later family, as the premise table says.
- No `*.user-text.ts` catalog entries, following the #34776 precedent for author-time findings.
- Contract review rework (head `72fe0c076`): `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` with `@objectstack/lint` at `minor`; `flow-condition-option-label` now reports a label only as its own field's comparand (`F == 'L'`, `'L' == F`, `!=`, `F in [...]`), so `record.stage == 'open' && record.name == 'Closed Lost'` is silent; a blank `objectName` gets its own message (the engine refuses an empty hook target, so the flow is never bound); the cron examples in `flows.mdx` and in the spec docblocks behind two reference pages state `timezone: 'UTC'`.
- Not covered by this PR, open on the card: decision-node and edge conditions for the label check (start conditions only), and a gate-side subflow check (F6 is CLI-only).

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd examples/app-todo && pnpm exec objectstack validate` exits 0 with no finding from the ten new rules; `os explain flow-condition-option-label` prints the rule's paragraphs.

Read first, by risk: `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-node-writes.ts` (`writtenValueFindings`, the two new errors on every CRUD write), `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts` (the record and time-relative blocks), `packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.ts` (`flowActionSignature`).

<details><summary>Test and gate readings</summary>

Head `4466c0cc8`. Same tree as `7bc8e8a6e` plus one module-top `import '@objectstack/lint';` in `protocol.package-closure-gate.test.ts`, which the test-source alias gate asked for. CI on `7bc8e8a6e`: every Test Core and Test UI shard, every Type Check lane and the dogfood gate passed. The only red was that alias step, and `node scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs` now reports OK locally.

- `@objectstack/lint`, the full suite under the verify lock: 228 files, 9503 tests passed.
- Lint dependents under the lock: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 365 files / 23352 tests, `@objectstack/service-automation` 293 / 4258, `@objectstack/verify` 55 / 500, `@objectstack/mcp` 83 / 1467. All passed, exit 0.
- The first CI run found one stale fixture in `metadata-protocol`: a sweep over the text field `title`, which the new date-field rule refuses. It now sweeps `created_at`, and the file passes 11/11.
- M2 red/green: with the previous `flow-select-options.ts` restored, the new pin "is silent when the label is the comparand of another field" fails (1 failed, 34 passed). With the fix, 35/35 pass.
- `@objectstack/spec` `src/migrations`: 200 tests passed. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, these all exit 0: `check:generated`, `check:api-surface`, `check:browser-reachable-entries`, `check:dual-source-exports`, `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`, `check:skill-examples`.
- Examples: `example-todo` 267/267 and `example-showcase` 554/554. `objectstack validate` on app-crm, app-todo and app-showcase exits 0 with no finding from the ten rules.
- Full dogfood battery, run on the first head (the rule code was unchanged in later heads apart from the label matcher): 487 files passed, 3 skipped; 4121 tests passed, 68 skipped; exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 122 derived families accounted for, 121 exit 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exits 3 here because it needs an unshallowed clone.
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: registered (BREAKING, bang, clause-② narrowing, metadata-protocol narrowed). `check-nul-bytes`: OK. Overlap-check against `origin/main` and #36629: clean.

</details>
